questions.question: How many absences are allowed for a class that meets once a week?
questions.reference_answer: Three meetings for a class meeting once a week.

questions.question: What is the maximum period for an approved leave of absence?
questions.reference_answer: A maximum of three consecutive terms; it must be renewed before it expires.

questions.question: If a student drops during the second week of classes, what percentage of tuition is deducted?
questions.reference_answer: 20% of total matriculation plus registration and ID fees.

questions.question: Can a student combine a sibling discount with the 10% cash discount?
questions.reference_answer: No. Only one scholarship or discount may be availed per term.

questions.question: What CGWA must a Don Mariano F. Jhocson Gold Scholar maintain?
questions.reference_answer: A cumulative general weighted average of at least 3.50.

questions.question: What is the uniform policy on Wednesdays and Saturdays?
questions.reference_answer: They are washdays; the prescribed uniform is not required.

questions.question: What documents are needed to replace a lost student ID?
questions.reference_answer: The procedure includes an Affidavit of Loss and the official receipt for the replacement fee.
